decision: Accept explicit assessed producer-root binding instead of current-consumer-root equality.
basis: Relative argv must be tied to actual execution root; equivalent checkout evidence portability means producer and consumer roots may differ. Existing manifest/capture environment is digest-bound and can carry explicit producer-root provenance without changing closed capture wire shape.
requirements: Require NIZAM_QA_EXECUTION_ROOT in QA candidate environment as lexically canonical absolute producer path.
At execution capture producer verifies reserved root equals actual canonical execution root and recorded capture cwd; explicit caller environment only, no implicit mutation.
Consumer requires capture cwd exact equality to declared assessed producer root and exact candidate/capture environment binding; do not require producer path to exist on consumer filesystem.
Consumer independently validates current repository, source tree, assessed material and index/current bytes, authorization context and stream bytes.
Regression producer-root mismatch, missing key, tampered cwd and valid portable fresh-clone consumption.
limitations: Metadata binding does not authenticate an untrusted local producer; existing non-goal remains.
